Consider lower price on sparkling (slow) or swap sparkling slot for cola.

Next day: restock crisps C1 x3 locations, gummy A1 MAIN/HOUSE, then LOUNGE gummy A1 (set 1.50). Depot energy ~37, sparkling ~13.
